test_case.test_name: Parameterized MLPerf v5.0 RetinaNet Server validation
test_case.purpose: Produce a compliant RetinaNet Server result with valid detection mAP and latency/QPS against a matched v5.0 reference.
required_package: Licensed v5.0 inference harness/LoadGen/RetinaNet model/detection data/calibration/preprocessing/config
test_case.test_command: Validate inference artifacts, detection preprocessing, hashes/licenses and GPU health; run the supported equivalent of `make run RUN_ARGS="--benchmarks=retinanet --scenarios=server"`; preserve mAP, Server LoadGen validity/QPS/P99 and telemetry; restore and compare only to matched v5.0 RetinaNet Server reference.
test_case.expected_result: Detection mAP and Server validity pass, QPS/latency meets approved delta and platform stays healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact RetinaNet Server inference, mAP, LoadGen validity and threshold. Training/BERT/Offline evidence cannot pass.
safety_gate: Verify detection dataset/preprocessing and Server profile.
test_case.recovery: On detection preprocessing or mAP failure, latency invalidity or GPU-memory pressure, stop the RetinaNet server container, retain COCO/data/calibration/LoadGen evidence, restore runtime/power state and quarantine invalid detection caches before rerun.
